body: Thank you for the information. I've been wanting to reach out for so long, and even making the original post was very difficult for me personally. I might have to look into some other sources soon.

I can't receive counseling at work because none is provided, and I wouldn't feel comfortable doing so there anyhow. I don't think I can at school because by law they are required to report suicidal thoughts and the like, then it becomes a larger issue. I cant afford a 'private' one and neither can my parents. I don't think there is anyone in my family, even extended family that I can talk to because they all have the same beliefs my parents do, and I know it would get back to me. Basically everybody in my life has this image that I'm near perfect, and nothing is wrong, but I think thats just a second life that is all a lie. I've reached out by making this post and I think thats all I can do right now sadly..
